data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 街角咖啡厅的虚张声势谈判
data.description: 街角阳光明媚的露天咖啡座，阿露换上了一身利落的米白风衣与高领针织衫。她双手捧着微烫的卡布奇诺咖啡杯，强行摆出一副老谋深算的商业大亨谈判架势。但在老师含笑的温柔注视下，她的耳尖悄悄红透，假装咳嗽轻抿奶泡。
data.location: sunlit outdoor cafe table on street corner
data.action: holding warm coffee cup, attempting stern poker face, subtle blush, coffee foam
data.lighting: warm dappled afternoon sunlight through terrace umbrella
data.mood: playful pretension and sweet cafe warmth
data.promptProse: Sitting across an outdoor cafe table in her beige trench coat, Rikuhachima Aru clutches a warm coffee cup, trying to look imposing while blushing nervously.
data.animaCaption: Aru attempting a cool business negotiation across a sunlit cafe table.
